result.topic_en: A general least-squares solution for three linear equations in two unknowns x, y, with explicit formulas for the residuals, x, y and the minimum sum of squared residuals.
result.transcription:
Allgemein,
$ax+by+m=e$ \quad a, b, m, a' u.s.w gegeben
$a'x+b'y+m'=e'$ \quad x, y gesucht, so dass
$a''x+b''y+m''=e''$ \quad $ee+e'e'+e''e''=\Sigma$
ein Minimum werde
Man setze
$a=b\theta,\ m=bn$
$a'=b'\theta',\ m'=b'n'$
$a''=b''\theta'',\ m''=b''n''$
N eine willkürliche Größe
$(n-N)(\theta''-\theta')+(n'-N)(\theta-\theta'')+(n''-N)(\theta'-\theta)=h$
$\frac{\theta''-\theta'}{b}=f,\ \frac{\theta-\theta''}{b'}=f',\ \frac{\theta'-\theta}{b''}=f''$
$\frac{h}{ff+f'f'+f''f''}=g$
Dann wird
1) $e=fg,\ e'=f'g,\ e''=f''g$
2) $(\theta''-\theta')x+(n''-n')=\left(\frac{f''}{b''}-\frac{f'}{b'}\right)g$ \quad Aus einer dieser
$(\theta-\theta'')x+(n-n'')=\left(\frac{f}{b}-\frac{f''}{b''}\right)g$ \quad Gleichungen
$(\theta'-\theta)x+(n'-n)=\left(\frac{f'}{b'}-\frac{f}{b}\right)g$ \quad wird x bestimmt
Endlich y aus einer der folgenden
3) $\theta x+y+n=\frac{e}{b}=\frac{f}{b}g$
$\theta'x+y+n'=\frac{e'}{b'}=\frac{f'}{b'}\cdot g$
$\theta''x+y+n''=\frac{e''}{b''}=\frac{f''}{b''}\cdot g$
und
$\Sigma=gh$

methods.what: Least-squares problem: three linear equations in two unknowns, minimize the sum of squared residuals
Normalization of coefficients by dividing by b
Auxiliary quantity h built from an arbitrary constant N
Definition of the scale factor g
